unit_note: USD millions. Department-level outlay lines from Table 3; each is standalone because this unit does not re-declare the full outlay roll-up (the sibling remainder unit holds the totals, and the department detail itself is Table 5's). Row COUNT is the check that matters here: strict coverage cannot see a missing standalone row. Department of Defense--Military Programs FYTD prints 916,836 with footnote 1 ("Amount decreased by $18 million due to additional reporting for the month of August 2026."); the text layer glues the marker as 1916,836, resolved against the page-8 render. Audit #510 restored the full comparison-period header from page 8.
